intro: A civil engineer and project manager whose work has developed across infrastructure, building construction, project controls, BIM and industry engagement.
journey: My professional foundation was built in Nigeria, where I worked across civil engineering, building construction and major highway infrastructure. At Julius Berger Nigeria Plc, I progressed from Technical Office Engineer to Section Engineer on the Abuja–Kaduna–Zaria–Kano Dual Carriageway Reconstruction Project.

Postgraduate study at Northumbria University broadened that practice into construction project management and Building Information Modelling. I completed the MSc with Distinction, while continuing to develop practical experience and professional relationships in the United Kingdom.

Alongside project work, I established Northumbria Construct to create more useful connections between students, universities, professional institutions and industry. My current interests include project controls, digital construction and practical industry–academia collaboration.
philosophy: Good project delivery depends on more than technical competence. It requires clear information, dependable relationships and systems that help people make sound decisions. I aim to bring those elements together in work that is useful, measured and accountable.

education.qualification: MSc Construction Project Management with Building Information Modelling
